text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 136, December 31, 1937 ]
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 73, SERIES OF 1936, ESTABLISHING AND CLASSIFYING
AIRPORTS AND LANDING FIELDS
1. Executive Order Numbered Seventy-three, promulgated on December third, nineteen hundred and
thirty-six, is hereby amended to include the following:
“I. NATIONAL AIRPORTS:
Camp Keitley (Dansalan) Landing Field
Jolo Landing Field
Iba Landing Field
“II. NATIONAL EMERGENCY LANDING FIELDS:
Bancase (Butuan) Landing Field
Malabang Landing Field
Culion Landing Field
Borongan Landing Field
Catarman Landing Field”
2. This Order shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-eight.
Done at the City of Manila, this thirty-first day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-seven, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the third.
(Sgd.) MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Secretary of the Interior
